A '''Geelan''' served as the [[Great Geel]], or leader, of the [[Geelan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] sometime after the event known as [[the Vanishing]]. The Great Geel made occasional visits to the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[Zirtran's Anchor/Legends|Zirtran's Anchor]]. Whenever he did so, he was accompanied by servants and a chief [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] named [[Tiny (bodyguard)|Tiny]].<ref name="ZA">{{JournalCite|5|Zirtran's Anchor (article)}}</ref>
